tasks.summary: The fix correctly restricts `findingDecisions` to only the designated final-consistency chunk of an actual impact attempt. `allowsDesignFindingDecisions` requires `attempt.impact` to be set AND `chunk.purpose==='consistency'` AND `chunk.id===attempt.plan.finalConsistencyChunkId`, so ordinary chunks, non-final consistency chunks, and even the initial attempt's final chunk (no impact set) are excluded. `designChunkResultSchema` returns `OrdinaryDesignResultSchema` (Type.Omit of `findingDecisions`, additionalProperties:false preserved) for all non-permitted chunks, and the full `DesignResultSchema` only for the permitted one. This schema selection is used consistently in exactly one place in the native coordinator (`coordinator.ts:289`), in the prompt's trailing structural-reference JSON (`policy.ts`), and in the live decode path (`results.ts: assessDesignResult` → `reconcileDesignFindings`, which independently re-asserts `result.findingDecisions===undefined||final`). The broad `DesignResultSchema` is correctly retained for historical/stored paths (checkpoint `DesignAttemptSchema.completedChunks`/`report`, the transport-level `DesignRequestSchemas.result` envelope decode, and `consolidateDesignReview`), so stored final decisions from past impact attempts still decode. All 5 submitted test files were executed against the current checkout and passed (25 test cases total across controller/coordinator/impact-consolidation/impact-execution/assignment-schema), and `tsc --noEmit` reported no errors.

testCoverage.explanation: Inspected the bodies/assertions of all three new tests in assignment-schema.test.ts plus the modified assertions in controller/coordinator/impact-consolidation/impact-execution tests. They cover: (1) the full permission matrix (no attempt, impact-less attempt, impact attempt) crossed with every chunk, verifying allowsDesignFindingDecisions/designChunkResultSchema/prompt schema/Codex strict schema all agree, plus a forged non-final consistency-purpose chunk is still denied; (2) that an ordinary chunk's schema rejects the field whether empty array, null, or populated, via both decodeDesign and the Codex transport validator and assessDesignResult, while a result without the field still passes; (3) that the permitted impact-final schema still accepts historical nullable transport decoding without mutating the broad DesignResultSchema (byte-for-byte snapshot check), and that decoding under DesignResultSchema (no chunk context) still succeeds for historical data while assessDesignResult without impactContext rejects the same decisions. Ran all 5 submitted test files against the actual committed code (git show confirmed the committed source matches the current checkout) — 25/25 cases passed. Also ran tsc --noEmit with zero errors.
